senses.gloss: m.a sort of spoon or fork, with one end pointed and the other broad (similar to the cochlear, v. כּוֹכְלִיאָר).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 25b:10">B. Mets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>סכיני וה׳</he> (Ms. R. <he>המנק</he>) knives and fork (which may have been cast on the dunghill inadvertently).
Succ. 32ᵃ דעביד כהימנק (Ms. M. והוא דעביד לה כי הימניק) when the palm-branch is formed like a himnek (Rashi: like the top of the stylus).
